status: PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_FITTING — thresholds below are frozen as of this record; changing them requires a successor record, not an edit
authority: owner instruction 2026-08-11: 'utilize all newly learned best practices and enhance our current models'
lane: ML (in-lane with the active ML-P4-FORWARD experiment; retrospective diagnostic only; does not touch the P4 forward queue, the frozen V13, or any card)

what_is_and_is_not_being_done.is: Three preregistered candidate improvements evaluated retrospectively against frozen V13 on identical games, under the full rigor stack this program has accumulated: expanding date-ordered walk-forward, fold-local standardization, inner-split penalty selection, date-block bootstrap, Holm correction, calibration and AUC gates, and a block ablation.
what_is_and_is_not_being_done.is_not: V13 is NOT modified (frozen 2026-08-10). No card changes. No promotion. Wagers remain 0/100 regardless of outcome — a model that clears every gate below earns a SHADOW dual-run slot, nothing more.
what_is_and_is_not_being_done.why_this_is_the_only_honest_route: The 2026-08-10 diagnostics established that a plausible-looking improvement (logistic vs base, t=-1.98) died under date-block bootstrap + Holm (p_holm 0.375), and that coefficient magnitude is not evidence. 'Enhance accuracy' therefore means: preregister, fit once, test hard, adopt only what survives.

learned_practices_applied: L1 (WNBA v0.4 audit M1): a classifier can silently contradict its own companion estimates — V13's measured pathology is compression toward .500. Candidate C1 attacks exactly this: walk-forward Platt recalibration of V13's own output, the analogue of the level/coherence fixes that repaired the WNBA card.
L2 (WNBA v0.4 audit M2): level terms and slowly-varying state matter. C3 adds the two as-of features computable from bytes on disk: rest-day edge and 10-game form edge.
L3 (v0.3 incident): no standardization of anything sparse/binary — all features here are continuous; standardization is fold-local only.
L4 (2026-08-10 corrections): every comparison goes through date-block bootstrap + Holm; nothing is claimed from a t-statistic alone.
L5 (fold-gate audits): thresholds are stated before data is seen and are arithmetic, not vibes.
L6 (V14 lesson): features requiring data not on disk (lineups, bullpen identity, travel) are NOT faked with proxies; they stay in V14's data-blocked queue.

candidates.C1_v13_platt: walk-forward Platt recalibration: at each date D fit logistic(y ~ a + b*logit(p_v13)) on all graded games strictly before D (min 300), apply to D's games. Two parameters; directly targets the measured compression. If V13 is well calibrated, b~1 and this changes nothing — the candidate is falsifiable by construction.
candidates.C2_logit7: ridge logistic on the frozen 7-feature set (sp_era_edge, team_rd_edge, off_edge, def_edge, sp_k_edge, sp_bb_edge, park), penalty chosen on an inner 80/20 split of the training window only. Re-run of the 8/10 candidate under this harness so C3's ablation is apples-to-apples.
candidates.C3_logit9: C2 plus rest_edge (capped at 5 days, home minus away) and form10_edge (mean run differential over up to the last 10 completed games, home minus away), both computed strictly as-of from results.csv.

protocol.data: features.csv rows with complete team form, intersected with the frozen V13 replay (v13_full_30k.jsonl) so every comparison is on identical games with identical labels
protocol.split: expanding window, date-ordered, burn_in 400 games (same as the 8/10 experiment); to predict date D, fit strictly on games before D
protocol.inference: paired Brier difference candidate-minus-V13, date-block bootstrap 4000 reps seed 11, two-sided
adoption_requires_ALL: p_holm < 0.05 on the candidate-vs-V13 Brier comparison, with the CI on the correct side
calibration slope in [0.85, 1.15] and intercept in [-0.15, 0.15]
ROC-AUC >= V13's AUC - 0.005 on the same games
for C3 additionally: the block ablation (C3 vs C2) must itself survive Holm — a win that vanishes without the new block is C2's win, not C3's
protocol.on_pass: register a new model identity, dual-run as DIAGNOSTIC shadow beside V13 on future cards; promotion to card-of-record requires a separate prospective gate; wagers stay 0/100 NO_PROMOTE regardless
protocol.on_fail: record NO_ADOPT with the numbers; V13 remains the sole card model; no retuning, no threshold movement, no second attempt without a successor prereg
